subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw accept sourceActor as a generic plugin SDK and memory recall contract now, with Signal as the first producer, or defer/narrow it until durable memory provenance is designed?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but adding a public attribution contract across channel, plugin tool, prompt, and memory seams is an API/product boundary choice automation should not finalize alone.

options.title: Approve Additive Contract
options.body: Land after the prerequisite stack is accepted or rebased, keeping sourceActor best-effort and non-authoritative while durable provenance remains separate.

options.title: Narrow Or Defer
options.body: Remove public memory/plugin exposure for now and continue provenance/trust design in the broader memory issues.

options.title: Split The Stack
options.body: Ask for a memory-only branch after the generic channel SourceActor prerequisite lands so this PR no longer carries Signal prerequisite changes.

recommendation.title: Approve Additive Contract
recommendation.body: Land after the prerequisite stack is accepted or rebased, keeping sourceActor best-effort and non-authoritative while durable provenance remains separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the channel, prompt, plugin SDK, and memory boundaries where recent current-main history points most strongly to him.
